verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents configuring SSO for non-gallery apps: there are no custom SAML, OIDC, or header-based setup walkthroughs. The closest item (docs-15) describes requesting that a SAML/OIDC app be added to the gallery, which is catalog onboarding rather than custom SSO configuration. The token and certificate management mention (docs-16) and Domain Services for legacy apps (docs-14) are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs
